notes: Conflicting-access SoD policies for the Demo Data entitlement catalog.
SOD-FIN-01 and SOD-SCM-03 conflict within a single birthright role; expect violations until those roles are split.
Five requestable SoD Demo roles in demo-access-model.json deliberately bundle both sides of SOD-FIN-03, SOD-HR-01, SOD-SEC-01, SOD-ENG-01, and SOD-SCM-01.
Mitigating controls are created via /controls/v1 and assigned on policies as allowedControls with type COMPENSATING_CONTROL.

policies.name: AP settlement vs payment release
policies.description: Invoice settlement must not combine with vendor payment release.
policies.compensatingControls: Split AP preparer and AP releaser duties; manager dual approval on payments.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Invoice Settlement Queue or Vendor Payment Release from the identity.

policies.name: Vendor master vs payment release
policies.description: Vendor master maintenance must not combine with vendor payment release.
policies.compensatingControls: Independent vendor master approval; treasury review of new payees.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Vendor Master Desk or Vendor Payment Release.

policies.name: Payment release vs bank portal
policies.description: ERP payment release must not combine with corporate bank portal access.

left.name: Payment release
roles: SoD Demo — Payment Release and Bank Portal

right.name: Bank portal
roles: SoD Demo — Payment Release and Bank Portal

policies.compensatingControls: Treasury dual control on bank portal; separate ERP releasers from bank operators.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Vendor Payment Release or Bank Portal Access.

policies.name: AR credit memo vs cash application
policies.description: Credit memo processing must not combine with cash application.
policies.compensatingControls: Manager approval on credit memos above threshold.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Credit Memo Desk or Cash App Desk.

policies.name: Ledger close vs audit workpapers
policies.description: Ledger close authority must not combine with internal audit workpapers.
policies.compensatingControls: Audit independence; workpapers owned by Internal Audit only.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Ledger Close Desk or Audit Workpaper Desk.

policies.name: ERP config vs control testing
policies.description: Financial ERP configuration must not combine with control testing.
policies.compensatingControls: Independent control testing by Internal Audit.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either ERP Config Desk or Control Test Desk.

policies.name: Payroll run vs compensation bands
policies.description: Payroll run processing must not combine with compensation band maintenance.

left.name: Payroll run
roles: SoD Demo — Payroll Run and Compensation Bands

right.name: Compensation bands
roles: SoD Demo — Payroll Run and Compensation Bands

policies.compensatingControls: Comp changes approved outside payroll; payroll reconciliations by a second person.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Payroll Run Desk or Comp Band Desk.

policies.name: Payroll processing vs equity plan admin
policies.description: Payroll processing entitlements must not combine with equity plan administration.
policies.compensatingControls: Equity grants approved by Compensation Committee; payroll cannot alter equity plans.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove payroll processing entitlements or Equity Plan Desk.

policies.name: Offer desk vs payroll calendar
policies.description: Employment offer authority must not combine with payroll calendar control.
policies.compensatingControls: Offer compensation validated by Compensation before payroll setup.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Offer Desk or Payroll Calendar Desk.

policies.name: ER cases vs payroll exceptions
policies.description: Employee relations cases must not combine with payroll exception processing.
policies.compensatingControls: ER settlements require payroll manager approval for pay adjustments.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either ER Case Desk or Payroll Exception Desk.

policies.name: Domain admin vs audit workpapers
policies.description: Windows domain operations must not combine with internal audit workpapers.

left.name: Domain operations
roles: SoD Demo — Domain Admin and Audit Workpapers

right.name: Audit workpapers
roles: SoD Demo — Domain Admin and Audit Workpapers

policies.compensatingControls: Audit independence from privileged IT operations.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Domain Ops Console or Audit Workpaper Desk.

policies.name: RACF admin vs audit planning
policies.description: Mainframe RACF administration must not combine with internal audit planning.
policies.compensatingControls: Audit plan ownership restricted to Internal Audit leadership.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Mainframe Access Desk or Audit Plan Desk.

policies.name: Firewall change vs security architecture
policies.description: Firewall change execution must not combine with security control blueprint ownership.
policies.compensatingControls: Architecture approves design; operations implements under change control.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Firewall Change Desk or Control Blueprint Desk.

policies.name: Schema change vs backup restore
policies.description: Database schema change must not combine with backup restore authority across platforms.
policies.compensatingControls: Separate change and restore duties; logged restore approvals.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Schema Change Desk or Backup Restore Desk.

policies.name: Production hotfix vs QA release signoff
policies.description: Production hotfix authority must not combine with QA release sign-off.

left.name: Production hotfixes
roles: SoD Demo — Production Hotfix and QA Signoff

right.name: QA release signoff
roles: SoD Demo — Production Hotfix and QA Signoff

policies.compensatingControls: Independent QA sign-off for production changes.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Hotfix Desk or Release Signoff Desk.

policies.name: Build pipeline gate vs QA release signoff
policies.description: Build pipeline promotion must not combine with QA release sign-off.
policies.compensatingControls: QA acceptance independent of engineering promotion rights.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Build Pipeline Gate or Release Signoff Desk.

policies.name: Staging code vs staging release board
policies.description: Staging development must not combine with staging release board authority.
policies.compensatingControls: Release board chaired by staging management, not committers.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Staging Code Bench or Staging Release Board.

policies.name: Purchase requisition vs contract desk
policies.description: Purchase requisitioning must not combine with procurement contract finalization.

left.name: Purchase requisitions
roles: SoD Demo — Requisition and Contract Desks

right.name: Contracts
roles: SoD Demo — Requisition and Contract Desks

policies.compensatingControls: Contract desk approval separate from requisitioner.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Purchase Requisition Desk or Contract Desk.

policies.name: Inbound receiving vs stock movement
policies.description: Inbound receiving must not combine with inventory stock movement posting.
policies.compensatingControls: Blind receiving; independent inventory posting.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Inbound Dock Desk or Stock Movement Desk.

policies.name: Stock movement vs cycle count
policies.description: Stock movement posting must not combine with cycle count execution.
policies.compensatingControls: Split movers and counters into separate roles before relying on preventive SoD.
policies.correctionAdvice: Remove either Stock Movement Desk or Cycle Count Desk.

mitigatingControls.name: Manager dual review
mitigatingControls.description: Manager reviews and attests the conflicting access combination for a limited period.

mitigatingControls.name: Treasury dual control
mitigatingControls.description: Treasury performs dual control review of payments and bank portal activity while the conflict remains.

mitigatingControls.name: Audit independence attestation
mitigatingControls.description: Internal Audit lead attests independence and documents why audit and operational access coexist temporarily.

mitigatingControls.name: Privileged change with CAB approval
mitigatingControls.description: CAB-approved change ticket covers the privileged conflict; access reviewed at change close.

mitigatingControls.name: Compensation committee exception
mitigatingControls.description: Compensation committee documents an approved exception for payroll/comp conflict.

mitigatingControls.name: Blind count with second verifier
mitigatingControls.description: Inventory movements require a second-person blind count verification while conflict is mitigated.

mitigatingControls.name: Remediate conflicting access
mitigatingControls.description: Certification campaign to remove one side of the conflicting access combination.
